items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree is required, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

A minimum of 3 years of experience with increasing responsibility in operations, data management, or data analytics. Previous experience with Technolutions Slate at an academic institution is preferred.
Review the organization, planning, and completion of applicant files.

Support all college application processing activities including the creation of application files, tracking and filing received application materials, data entry of application information, and answering application inquiries.
Serve as a point of contact for applicants, their parents, and school counselors regarding application materials.
Provide data support and judgment regarding the processing of application materials.
Coordinate the receipt and processing of application documents from transfer and veteran applicants.
Coordinate the receipt of enrollment documents and verification of enrolling student information.
Manage admissions data processing, cleanup, and input assignments as directed.
Seek and initiate methods of conducting duties and responsibilities to produce greater efficiency.
Monitor submission of final transcripts, gap year, and summer melt.

Coordinate with and process paperwork as appropriate for students requesting, taking, and returning from gap year(s), including fielding questions and maintaining contact with students on gap year leave.
Audit and update existing Slate reports and dashboards to ensure accuracy.
Maintain and adjust reports in Slate, including annual updates to keep them in sync with our cycles.
Assist with the preparation of external reports including IPEDS, Common Data Set, Princeton Review, Fiske and others.
